idea-plugin.name: Function Inline Viewer
idea-plugin.description:
Read code without leaving the call site. Function Inline Viewer adds a small hint after every call to a function that is defined in your project; click it and the function's body unfolds right below the call. Click again to fold it. No popups, no jumping between files.

  • Nested unfolding — calls inside an unfolded body get their own hints, so you can follow a call chain down several levels (depth is configurable).
  • Syntax and semantic colors — the unfolded code is highlighted like the editor, with parameters, fields, methods and classes colored by kind.
  • Cmd/Ctrl+click navigation inside unfolded code, plus hover highlighting that pairs a hint with the name it belongs to.
  • Interfaces and overrides — unfold an abstract method or an overridable method and load its implementations or overrides on demand (paged, with "next" and "all").
  • Method chains such as a.foo().bar() are merged into a single hint. Several calls on one line get different colors (configurable in the color scheme).
  • Stays fresh — unfolded bodies update while you edit the caller or the callee, and are restored when you reopen the project. Fold all with Ctrl+Cmd+- (macOS) / Ctrl+Alt+-.
  • Only project sources get hints; library and JDK calls are ignored.
  • Works with Java and Kotlin (including extension functions, lambdas and custom property accessors).

Settings: Settings | Editor | Function Inline Viewer (maximum lines, nesting depth, chain merging) and Settings | Editor | Color Scheme | Function Inline Viewer (colors). The hints can be switched off under Settings | Editor | Inlay Hints | Other.

action.description: Folds every function body unfolded below a call in the editor
